0: Street-scene level data (maps, tile and object tables). No code of its own: the fixed bank selects it as data (MmcPrgShadow = 0 runs the fixed-bank main code instead of $8010).
1: Street-scene object and enemy routines (object table at $0310, 16 bytes each) and the game-over screen ('The man with the custom M-16').
2: Sniper-scope scenes and palette tables (LoadPaletteSet reads them here).
3: Dialogue and briefing scenes (portrait text boxes).
4: Per-frame scene code at $8010 (scene not identified yet).
5: Intro, Vic Tokai logo, title screen, act title cards and the 'To be continued' screen.
6: Per-frame scene code at $8010 (scene not identified yet).
7: Fixed bank: reset, NMI, PPU / MMC1 / joypad helpers and the street-scene gameplay loop.
